---
id: env.excl.property-you-own-or-occupy
type: exclusion
heading: Property You Own or Occupy
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Property damage to property owned, leased, rented or occupied by you, or in your care, custody or control. This exclusion does not apply to clean-up costs at a covered location under [[ref:env.cover.site-pollution-legal-liability]], or to clean-up costs at a job site that environmental law requires.
